title: Cross-campaign character custody lifecycle (revisions, sync-back, fork)
description: Build the custody/transfer lifecycle on the registry foundation (ADR 0012, eshyra-lupf.14.2): a linear per-character revision history in the registry; attach = check-out (marks custody, records source revision on the campaign sheet); on campaign exit, commit a new revision back to the registry from the campaign character_sheet; prevent silent double-attach of one character to multiple active campaigns; explicit, rare alternate-timeline fork as a deliberate operation. Ensures exactly one writer at a time (no cross-DB write races).
acceptance_criteria:
- Registry tracks a linear revision history per globalCharacterId.
- Attach records source revision + custody on the campaign sheet; exit commits a new registry revision from the campaign sheet.
- Double-attach to multiple active campaigns is prevented unless an explicit fork is chosen.
- Explicit alternate-timeline fork is supported and clearly labeled as breaking continuity.
- Tests cover checkout->play->sync-back->re-checkout and the double-attach guard.
close_reason: Implemented custody lifecycle (revisions, checkout/sync-back/release, double-attach guard, fork) in core + CLI wiring; PR #331. Follow-up eshyra-lupf.14.4 for CLI fork/non-head-checkout UX.
